title: Qin Jiushao's method for solving polynomials
summary: In his Mathematical Treatise in Nine Sections, Qin Jiushao set out the procedure for solving polynomial equations now taught as Horner's method.
why: Still the standard way computers evaluate polynomials.

unsung.contribution: Discovered the efficient polynomial-solving procedure now known as Horner's method.
unsung.recognition: The method is known today by another man's name, Horner's method.
